"""Bounded runtime witness; this does not invent a selective scope rule."""
import json
from polisyos.ir import UncertaintyType
from polisyos.scientist.methods.search.funnel.level0_static import Level0StaticValidator
from polisyos.scientist.methods.search.funnel.level4_full import Level4FullFidelity
from polisyos.scientist.methods.search.funnel.orchestrator import FunnelOrchestrator
from polisyos.scientist.methods.search.uncertainty import UncertaintyEnvelope, UncertaintyEstimate
from polisyos.scientist.orchestration.workflows import SimpleLoopEngine

def estimate(state):
    return {**state, 'simulation_results': {'ate': 2.0, 'gdp_change': 2.0, 'bootstrap': {'ci_width': 0.4}}, 'feedback': {'verdict': 'APPROVE'}}
engine=SimpleLoopEngine([('estimate',estimate)],terminal_node='estimate')
orch=FunnelOrchestrator([Level0StaticValidator(),Level4FullFidelity(engine)])
outcome=orch.advance(orch.submit({'candidate_id':'scope-fixture','semantic': {'interventions':[{'type':'tax_reform','parameters':{'income_tax_rate':.25}}],'objectives':[{'name':'gdp_growth','variable':'gdp'}]}}, {'dataset_version':'subject-A-v1','evaluation_role':'ordinary'}),policy='full')
stat=UncertaintyType.STATISTICAL
final=outcome.final_result
independent=UncertaintyEnvelope.from_partial({stat:UncertaintyEstimate(level=.8,source='fixture independent risk',quantification_method='fixture supplied observation',is_reducible=False)})
witness={'runtime_path':'native L0 -> real SimpleLoopEngine estimate -> native L4 -> FunnelOrchestrator.get_outcome',
 'history_statistical':outcome.uncertainty_envelope.uncertainties[stat].level,
 'final_statistical':final.uncertainty_envelope.uncertainties[stat].level,
 'current_feedback_statistical':final.feedback['uncertainty_current']['uncertainties'][stat.value]['level'],
 'independent_risk_fixture':.8,
 'merge_final_with_independent':UncertaintyEnvelope.merge_max([final.uncertainty_envelope,independent]).uncertainties[stat].level,
 'estimate_fields':sorted(UncertaintyEstimate.model_fields),
 'scope_admission':'not established: no subject/value/input/rule/time discriminator on estimate; current feedback is only last stage envelope'}
print(json.dumps(witness,indent=2))
assert witness['history_statistical']==1.0 and witness['final_statistical']==.1
assert witness['merge_final_with_independent']==.8
